timing.summary: The archive-path build blocker is introduced by the relocation: the same old harness path matches the before build and misses the after build.

claims.necessity_reason: The review established that this target must link the Autotools-built libcares archive.

before.requirement: Link the fuzzer against the root-level Autotools libcares archive.
before.reason: Before the change, the root Makefile defines libcares.la; the old harness links its root .libs archive.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before in-tree test rules also locate libcares at the build root.

after.requirement: Link the fuzzer against the libcares archive built under src/lib.
after.reason: After the change, the root build delegates to subdirectories and src/lib defines the library target, while the old harness still names the root archive.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The after in-tree test rules identify the relocated library path.

claims.comparison_reason: The fixed harness requests the same root archive on both sides. That path corresponds to the before library target but not the after target.
